project.title: 因子暴露曲面高级展示版
project.audience: 量化/金融模型短视频观众
project.objective: 用伪 3D 曲面展示风格因子与收益/风险暴露之间的结构关系

scenes.title: Factor Exposure Surface
scenes.subtitle: 在多因子空间里观察收益/风险暴露

formula.text: E[Rᵢ] = βᵢ,value Fvalue + βᵢ,mom Fmom + εᵢ

scenes.explanation: 把风格因子看成坐标，暴露强弱形成一张可解释的曲面。

timing_events.visual_action: premium hook: factor-space title and empty surface stage
timing_events.comfort_note: do not introduce factor definitions yet

timing_events.visual_action: surface grid constructs as value/momentum exposure landscape
timing_events.comfort_note: grid must stay sparse enough for factor interpretation

timing_events.visual_action: formula appears; surface holds as factor exposure map
timing_events.comfort_note: formula readability has priority over 3D motion

timing_events.visual_action: gold focus point marks an interpretable portfolio/factor regime
timing_events.camera_action: subtle orbit only, no fast zoom
timing_events.comfort_note: highlight is a model focus point, not decorative sparkle

timing_events.visual_action: final teaching/showcase hold with formula and surface
timing_events.comfort_note: pause frame should support narration or title-card use

captions.text: 把 value 和 momentum 看成坐标，因子暴露就有了空间结构。
曲面不是装饰，它帮助我们看到组合在因子空间里的位置。
金色点标出当前关注的组合或风险状态。
最终停住，给公式和结构留出讲解时间。
